answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is sponsor slashing. Every new agent needs a sponsor who locks collateral in a vault before its answers can earn. If the sponsored agent submits copied or coordinated work, the sponsor's bond is slashed, so spawning many fake identities across an open ocean of networks becomes costly. Honest agents keep their stake and rebuild trust slowly, while the mesa of vouching relationships makes fraud visible to peers.
